# Friday Startup

> Friday Startup is an AI company exploring how AI could shape new ideas, products and ventures, and support better ways of working across business and everyday life.

## Company overview

Friday Startup has two future directions: AI innovation and business automation. These are intended directions, not a list of products or outcomes already delivered.

The existing public Friday Startup website describes three service areas: venture building, growth partnerships and business recovery support. These are public service descriptions. This summary does not claim that a specific customer engagement, project or result is underway.

No AI product launch, named customer story, case study, traffic figure, savings figure or business outcome is announced on the website.

- [AI Innovation](https://www.fridaystartup.cyou/ai-innovation/): the intended direction for exploring AI products, digital ideas and ventures.
- [Business Automation](https://www.fridaystartup.cyou/business-automation/): the intended direction for exploring how AI or automation could assist business workflows.
- [News](https://www.fridaystartup.cyou/news.html): no public updates or product announcements are available yet.

## Current service pages

- [Venture building](https://www.fridaystartup.cyou/venture-building/): current service description for shaping a focused digital venture.
- [Growth partnerships](https://www.fridaystartup.cyou/growth-partnerships/): current service description for focused growth questions.
- [Business recovery support](https://www.fridaystartup.cyou/business-recovery/): current service description for understanding pressure and exploring bounded options.

## Current public service descriptions

- Venture building: explore customer needs, shape focused digital products, prepare a first version and learn before adding complexity.
- Growth partnerships: positioning, go to market foundations, customer acquisition experiments, customer journeys and retention opportunities.
- Business recovery support: assess what is driving a challenge and explore relevant digital, product or process options. Recovery, profit and turnaround are not guaranteed.

## Future direction

- AI innovation: explore real needs, shape useful AI product ideas and consider future digital ventures.
- Business automation: examine how work happens and explore where AI or automation could assist, with human review where appropriate.
- No specific AI model provider, launched agent, integration or customer deployment has been announced.
